# Unsloth LoRA / QLoRA Fine-Tuning for Runpod Serverless

> A Runpod Hub Serverless worker that fine-tunes Hugging Face causal LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, and others supported by Unsloth) with LoRA or 4-bit QLoRA SFT. You send a base model and a chat or alpaca dataset; you get a LoRA adapter on a network volume and optionally on the Hugging Face Hub. This is an Unsloth Runpod template for API-first fine-tuning, not a Studio Pod.

Use this file to decide what to read next. Prefer the raw Markdown links. Deploy from the Runpod Hub (the console URL is live only after moderation): https://console.runpod.io/hub/prilojject/runpod-unsloth-finetune

Always use async POST /run for training, raise policy.executionTimeout (default 600s is too short; max 7 days), attach a network volume, and put HF_TOKEN in a Runpod secret — never in the job input. Start with "dry_run": true to validate data without downloading weights. Output is a LoRA adapter only (no merged weights, no GGUF, no DPO/vision/multi-GPU).
